WITH cohort_2007 AS (
    SELECT CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING toYear(MIN(DateKey)) = 2007
),
returned_2008 AS (
    SELECT f.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    INNER JOIN cohort_2007 c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008
    GROUP BY f.CustomerKey
),
returned_2009 AS (
    SELECT f.CustomerKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    INNER JOIN returned_2008 r ON f.CustomerKey = r.CustomerKey
    WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY f.CustomerKey
)
SELECT
    count(DISTINCT c.CustomerKey)                                          AS cohort_2007_customers,
    count(DISTINCT r8.CustomerKey)                                         AS returned_in_2008,
    round(count(DISTINCT r8.CustomerKey) * 100.0
          / nullIf(count(DISTINCT c.CustomerKey), 0), 2)                  AS retention_2007_to_2008_pct,
    count(DISTINCT r9.CustomerKey)                                         AS returned_in_2009,
    round(count(DISTINCT r9.CustomerKey) * 100.0
          / nullIf(count(DISTINCT r8.CustomerKey), 0), 2)                 AS retention_2008_to_2009_pct
FROM cohort_2007 c
LEFT JOIN returned_2008 r8 ON c.CustomerKey = r8.CustomerKey
LEFT JOIN returned_2009 r9 ON r8.CustomerKey = r9.CustomerKey
